About this app
arrow_forward
With this app, you can view bids and re-arrange locations and commodities to your preference. Submit offers and contracts, from the bid screen as well as edit and withdraw them from the Offers screen. View your Contracts by Commodity. View your Account Balances by location and make offers/contracts against them too. You can also view your Scale Tickets. Receive and view notifications and access your local weather. 
View bids and submit, edit and withdraw offers and contracts.
